layers.guideTitle: Step 1: Choose the layers that participate in combinations.
layers.guideBefore: Select layers or groups and make them an option group below, or click
layers.guideAfter: to make each child an option (for example, short / long hair). Layers outside option groups keep their PSD visibility in every export; click the eye beside a layer to show or hide it.
layers.compareTitle: Render the visibility saved in the PSD and compare pixel by pixel with its composite
layers.legend: Legend: open eye = visible; yellow open eye = visible itself but hidden by a parent group; closed eye = hidden. Blue labels after a layer name show its option group. Atomic groups can be expanded, but their layers cannot become separate options.
